best_idea: Add chunked digit parsing (2 or 4 digits at a time) for the integer part in the fast path to reduce loop overhead, with a tunable chunk size parameter for sweeping.

best_lineage.idea: Implement a fast path for integers and short decimals using direct parsing with uint64_t mantissa accumulation and exact power-of-10 scaling, falling back to std::strtod only for complex cases.

The fast path incorrectly truncates the mantissa to 19 digits while using the full decimal exponent, causing wrong results for numbers with leading zeros in the fractional part. Fix by tracking total digits parsed and only using the fast path when total digits ≤ 19 (so mantissa is exact).
